title: TSOA Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TSOA_Position_Estimator.md
text: Estimate target position from time-sum of arrival, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Output covariances of TSOA position estimates (meters-squared)} sets the output covariance of TSOA position and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: TSOAEst
ports.summary: Time-sum of arrival estimates (sec) real-valued J -by- L -by- K array

ports.name: TSOAVar
ports.summary: TSOA estimation variance (seconds-squared) real-valued J -by- L matrix | real-valued J -by- L -by- K array

ports.name: TxPos
ports.summary: Transmitting anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- J matrix

ports.name: RxPos
ports.summary: Receiving anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- L matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: Target position estimate real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: Target position covariance matrix real-valued positive semi-definite Q -by- Q matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst("LightSpeed") (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output covariances of TSOA position estimates (meters-squared)
params.values: Output covariance of TSOA position estimates false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
